headline: This open-source project lets you sync Withings data to other apps without a subscription
summary: An open-source project now allows Withings data syncing without a subscription. Users can bypass the new Withings Plus paywall for health data. The developer was motivated by a 'bloated' app and new fees.

headline: Joshua Kushner’s Thrive Holdings is acquiring ADT for $7.6 billion
summary: Joshua Kushner's Thrive Holdings is set to acquire ADT. The deal is an all-cash transaction valued at $7.6 billion. ADT will go private once the acquisition closes in Q1 2027.

headline: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to approximately 60,000 employees globally. CEO Satya Nadella's strategy hints at AI fundamentally changing the workforce size. This move signals a leaner, AI-driven future for the company.

headline: The NYT Cooking app is testing AI recipe modifications
summary: The New York Times Cooking app is testing an AI feature for recipe modifications. It suggests ingredient substitutions, equipment alternatives, and scales recipes. The experimental tool has sparked user debate and 'drama.'

headline: Star Wars: See an Exclusive Preview of The Art of The Mandalorian and Grogu
summary: An exclusive preview of 'The Art of The Mandalorian and Grogu' has been revealed. It showcases concept art from the popular Star Wars series. Featured designs include characters like Embo and the Anzellans.

headline: Why the Pokémon Franchise Is Ripe for an R-Rated Horror Movie Adaptation
summary: Analysis explores the potential for an R-rated horror movie based on Pokémon. The article delves into the franchise's dark elements suitable for horror. It suggests a mature, terrifying reimagining of the beloved universe.

headline: The Hellraiser Franchise Is Getting Three New Tabletop Adaptations for Halloween 2027
summary: Three new tabletop adaptations are coming for the Hellraiser franchise. These new games are slated for release by Halloween 2027. The iconic horror series is expanding into board game formats.

headline: PlayStation Launches Early Black Friday Deal With £20 Off Special Edition PS5 Controllers
summary: PlayStation has launched an early Black Friday deal on PS5 DualSense controllers. Shoppers can get £20 off select special edition designs. The promotion is valid until November 6th; details on eligible controllers available.

headline: Burnham says he wants to cut welfare bill 'as soon as we possibly can'
summary: Andy Burnham states his desire to reduce the welfare bill quickly. Opponents criticize the Budget for lacking specific welfare reform details. No clear timetable for welfare reductions has been outlined.

headline: 'Painful' years ahead, think tanks warn, as living standards set to fall
summary: Think tanks predict 'painful' years ahead for the economy. Living standards are forecasted to fall or stagnate significantly. Budget projections show minimal growth in household income.

headline: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash
summary: Recordings reveal communications between control and drivers before a fatal Spain train crash. A high-speed train was cleared to move despite another being stalled ahead. The audio exposes potential miscommunications leading to the disaster.

headline: Russell Brand's wife tells his rape trial he is 'kind and a wonderful father'
summary: Russell Brand's wife, Laura, testified in his rape trial. She described him as 'kind and a wonderful father' in court. Laura Brand expressed feeling 'very seen by him' and profound love.
